title: introduce-invocation-lifespan-telemetry-and-alert-attenuator
author: Marisa Chen
release_notes: Adds phase-aware invocation telemetry and alert attenuation. No user-facing breaking changes; new metrics and dashboards for SREs and platform owners.
description:
Motivation: Long-tail alert noise and cost attribution errors are frequently caused by short-lived or transient invocations (e.g. interactive CLI calls, probe requests, and ephemeral batch jobs) that skew token-level latency/cost aggregates. This PR introduces a phase-aware "invocation lifespan" telemetry surface and an alert attenuation adapter that reduces false positives from transient invocations while preserving signal for sustained regressions.

What this PR does (single string description): Adds an invocation lifecycle enrichment that tags spans and metrics with invocation_phase values (init, warmup, steady, teardown), emits phase-durations and phase-token-cost metrics, provides a new dashboard with phase-aligned latency/cost breakdowns, implements a configurable alert attenuator that silences or downweights alerts dominated by short-lived invocations, and adds a small sampling policy so high-volume short invocations don't over-index metrics. Includes end-to-end tests and docs.

Checklist:
- [x] Instrumentation: span and metric enrichers for invocation_phase and phase_durations
- [x] Metrics: new metrics export (invocation.phase.duration_ms, invocation.phase.token_cost) with labels for model, route, tenant
- [x] Tracing: span attribute propagation and a lightweight phase marker in the root span
- [x] Dashboard: phase-aware latency/cost breakdown, short-invocation cohort filter, and long-tail alert explorer
- [x] Alerting: attenuation adapter that can be toggled per-tenant or per-route
- [x] Tests: integration test in observability harness; unit tests for attenuator logic
- [x] Docs: console docs and runbook for interpreting phase charts and tuning attenuation thresholds

Backward compatibility notes: All new metrics use new metric names and labels; existing dashboards remain unchanged. The attenuator defaults to disabled for all customers; enabling is a safe opt-in.

Data volume concerns: sampling defaults to 10% for invocations with lifetime < 250ms to bound cardinality; sampling rate is configurable per-tenant.

Operational notes: On merge we will roll the feature on to the staging observability cluster, validate dashboards with a 48h synthetic run, then enable the attenuator in canary mode for internal tenants only.

Context / Related work: This complements ENG-4520 (token phase attribution) and ENG-4721 (cohort-aware alerting). It is intended to reduce alert churn and improve per-token cost attribution for SLA dashboards.
